Full sweep completed: inspected every hunk in the supplied 13-file diff, reviewing how original PR head 152d43aa4535c73a7d642fcb8cbbb5d0e5d45021 would land on protected main cca5773b3aec0e36e91af442a497ed49301a2ed3 (landed tree 7665416f445c9a96a5b05e4c3c7bb9f4a89ed177). Covered spec: BUG-2671, resolved with aida show --full despite the generated prompt reporting it missing. One actionable AC2 gap remains.
Acceptance criteria, enumerated before verdict selection:
BUG-2671 AC1 (install step survives a slow mirror): not-applicable-because the spec explicitly assigns AC1 to PR #4246; this split covers AC2 and AC3.
BUG-2671 AC2 (classify pre-test dependency-install or other infrastructure failure distinctly and retry once rather than ejecting): unverified. Source inspection verifies the dependency-install case through train_infrastructure_failure/read_train_infrastructure_failure, the new pinned-job classifier/live-forge fixtures, and existing drive_reruns_an_infra_red_once_then_lands_the_same_composition and retry-exhaustion fixtures. However, checkout infrastructure failure is excluded and still takes the test-red/ejection path, as detailed in the finding.
BUG-2671 AC3 (Test time budget reports tests did not run instead of raising FileNotFoundError when tests never ran): verified by source inspection of the job-local marker plus missing-log guard in .github/workflows/ci.yml and the regression test_timing_step_reports_tests_did_not_run in tests/test_ci_test_shards.py, which covers absent marker/log and stale cached logs. Compile derivation and its structural assertion are updated consistently.
Type protocol checklist: BUG-2671 (bug protocol: PR touches at least one test file): met; changes include tests/test_ci_test_shards.py and aida-cli-lib/src/tests/story_1690_train_tests.rs. Relevant implementation and regression traces are present.
No local tests or builds were run, per reviewer policy. Existing implementer evidence reports 177 train tests and focused Python/structural suites passing before publication. Exact-head forge evidence shows CI (fast gates) succeeded; CI (fast compile) failed at Install compile dependencies before compilation, and Build mirrors that failure. These CI failures are not themselves a review finding or a WAITING dependency.
The PR is six commits behind the protected base. The base-side forge.rs publication-head changes and git-lifecycle documentation changes were inspected and do not affect the finding, which is in unchanged-between-head-and-landed-tree pr_train.rs. The supplied host CodeGraph executable is absent; aida doctor check codegraph reports an unreachable index. Navigation used rg and source inspection instead.
